cards.sentence: Kläder som ska tvättas lägger vi i en tvättkorg.
cards.sentence_en: Clothes that need washing we put in a laundry basket.
The clothes in a laundry basket are called dirty laundry.
cards.note: smuts (dirt) + tvätt (laundry).

cards.sentence_en: The laundry room is in the basement.
cards.note: Most Swedish apartment buildings have a shared tvättstuga that you book.

cards.sentence: Källaren är våningen under marken i ett hus.
cards.sentence_en: The basement is the floor below ground in a building.
cards.note: en våning = a floor, storey.

cards.sentence: För att använda tvättstugan måste vi boka en tid.
cards.sentence_en: To use the laundry room we have to book a time.

cards.sentence: Jag bokar tiden genom att hänga upp ett hänglås.
cards.sentence_en: I book the time by hanging up a padlock.
cards.note: hänga (hang) + lås (lock).

cards.sentence: I Sverige säger vi ofta jag har tvättid.
cards.sentence_en: In Sweden we often say 'I have laundry time'.
cards.note: tvätt + tid, also written tvätt-tid. Swedes really do plan their week around it.

cards.sentence: Du kan också säga jag ska tvätta kläder, men det räcker att säga jag har tvättid.
cards.sentence_en: You can also say 'I'm going to wash clothes', but it's enough to say 'I have laundry time'.
cards.note: Det räcker! = That's enough! Also 'to pass/hand': räck mig saltet.

cards.sentence_en: 'Tvättid', because we're lazy.

cards.sentence: I tvättstugan finns tvättmaskiner och en torktumlare.
cards.sentence_en: In the laundry room there are washing machines and a tumble dryer.
cards.note: torka (dry) + tumla (tumble).

cards.sentence_en: The washing machine has a door.
cards.note: A small door or hatch; an advent calendar has luckor too.

cards.sentence: Jag vill bara ha smutstvätt upp till hälften.
cards.sentence_en: I only want dirty laundry up to the halfway mark.
cards.note: halv = half (adjective): en halv liter.

cards.sentence: Tur att det finns en till tvättmaskin.
cards.sentence_en: Lucky there's another washing machine.
cards.note: Vilken tur! = How lucky! Opposite: otur = bad luck.

cards.sentence: Det räcker att jag säger maskin, men jag menar tvättmaskin.
cards.sentence_en: It's enough that I say machine, but I mean washing machine.
cards.note: Of a person's intention. For a word's meaning: betyda.

cards.sentence: Eftersom jag är i tvättstugan är det underförstått att jag menar tvättmaskin.
cards.sentence_en: Since I'm in the laundry room, it's understood that I mean washing machine.

cards.sentence: Underförstått är ett lite avancerat ord, men det är användbart, så det får du lära dig.
cards.sentence_en: 'Underförstått' is a slightly advanced word, but it's useful, so you get to learn it.
cards.note: Det är underförstått = it goes without saying.

cards.sentence_en: This is detergent.
cards.note: -medel = agent, product: diskmedel, rengöringsmedel.

cards.sentence_en: A little bit is enough.

cards.sentence: Och här kan man hälla i sköljmedel.
cards.sentence_en: And here you can pour in fabric softener.
cards.note: skölja = to rinse.

cards.forms: är slut · var slut · har varit slut
cards.english: to be finished, to have run out
cards.sentence: Jag brukar också ha sköljmedel, men det var slut.
cards.sentence_en: I usually have fabric softener too, but it had run out.
cards.note: Mjölken är slut = we're out of milk. Also jag är slut = I'm exhausted.

cards.forms: häller upp · hällde upp · har hällt upp
cards.sentence: Jag kan säga att jag häller upp tvättmedel eller häller i tvättmedel.
cards.sentence_en: I can say I pour out detergent or I pour in detergent.
cards.note: hälla upp kaffe = pour coffee (into a cup).

cards.sentence_en: Both work.
cards.note: Casual form of fungera. Det funkar inte = it doesn't work.

cards.sentence: Då trycker jag på den här knappen.
cards.sentence_en: Then I press this button.
cards.note: en knapp = a button (also on clothes).

cards.sentence_en: Here I can choose a programme.
cards.note: ett val = a choice; also an election.

cards.sentence: Jag kan vrida för att välja program.
cards.sentence_en: I can turn (the knob) to choose a programme.
cards.note: Strong verb: vrida – vred – vridit.

cards.sentence: Då trycker jag på den knappen och vrider eller skruvar.
cards.sentence_en: Then I press that button and turn or twist it.
cards.note: en skruv = a screw. skruva upp volymen = turn up the volume.

cards.sentence_en: Now both machines are running.
cards.note: Also about people: Jag är igång idag = I'm full of energy today.

cards.forms: håller på att · höll på att
cards.english: to be in the middle of (doing)
cards.sentence_en: They're busy washing.
cards.note: Makes the English '-ing': Jag håller på att laga mat = I'm cooking.

cards.sentence_en: Here the clothes can dry.
cards.note: torka bordet = wipe the table. Adjective: torr = dry.

cards.sentence: Men det finns också ett torkrum för att torka kläder.
cards.sentence_en: But there's also a drying room for drying clothes.

cards.forms: värmer upp · värmde upp · har värmt upp
cards.english: to heat up, to warm up
cards.sentence: Jag ska värma upp torkrummet genom att sätta på det här aggregatet.
cards.sentence_en: I'm going to heat up the drying room by turning on this unit.
cards.note: Also before sport: värma upp = warm up.

cards.sentence_en: So first I switch on the power.
cards.note: strömavbrott = power cut. Also a stream or current of water.

cards.sentence_en: Now the unit started.
cards.note: Technical word for a machine unit, here the drying room's heater fan.

cards.sentence_en: Well, we can brew some coffee.
cards.note: bryggkaffe = filter coffee. Jo answers a question with 'well, yes'.

cards.sentence_en: This is a coffee maker.

cards.sentence: Kaffe har jag i den här burken.
cards.sentence_en: I keep coffee in this jar.
cards.note: en konservburk = a tin can.

cards.sentence_en: And here's a measuring scoop.
This is a scoop.
Freshly ground coffee of the highest quality.
cards.note: ny- = freshly, newly: nybakad, nytvättad. mala = to grind.

cards.sentence: Nu sätter jag på det lilla locket.
cards.sentence_en: Now I put on the little lid.
cards.note: Not a lock (= ett lås). en lock is a curl of hair.

cards.sentence: Då tar jag locket och jag tar kaffekannan och jag fyller den med vatten.
cards.sentence_en: So I take the lid and I take the coffee pot and fill it with water.
Here it shows the number of cups.
cards.note: A count of things. A number as a figure is en siffra or ett nummer.

cards.sentence: Nu sätter jag på locket igen och häller ut resten av vattnet.
cards.sentence_en: Now I put the lid back on and pour out the rest of the water.
cards.note: rester = leftovers (food).

cards.sentence_en: Here's soil.
cards.note: Jorden with a capital J = the Earth.

cards.sentence_en: Here in the cupboard there are lots of cups.
cards.note: kylskåp = fridge, klädskåp = wardrobe.

cards.sentence_en: Just a splash.
cards.note: en skvett mjölk = a dash of milk.

cards.sentence_en: This is a duvet.
cards.note: A thinner blanket is en filt.

cards.sentence: Och här är två gardiner för att avskilja sovrummet och min studio.
cards.sentence_en: And here are two curtains to separate the bedroom and my studio.
cards.note: avskilja = to separate, divide off.

cards.sentence: Som ni vet jobbar jag som musiker, så jag behöver en studio med lite instrument och högtalare och lite galna tavlor.
cards.sentence_en: As you know I work as a musician, so I need a studio with some instruments and speakers and some crazy pictures.
cards.note: jobba som + job, without en.

cards.sentence_en: And here's a litter box.

cards.forms: går av · gick av · har gått av
cards.sentence_en: But a string has snapped.
cards.note: en sträng = a string (on an instrument). Also gå av bussen = get off the bus.

cards.sentence: Det är lite stökigt här just nu för jag har rest mycket och plockat massa grejer.
cards.sentence_en: It's a bit messy here right now because I've travelled a lot and picked up lots of stuff.
cards.note: grejer = stuff, things (casual).

cards.sentence_en: But it doesn't matter.
cards.note: en roll = a role.

cards.sentence: Jag är inte här för att visa hur städat jag har hemma.
cards.sentence_en: I'm not here to show how tidy my home is.
cards.note: Verb: städa = to clean, tidy up.

cards.sentence_en: It's not very orderly.
cards.note: Det är i ordning = it's fine, sorted.

cards.sentence_en: It's messy on my desk.
cards.note: skriva (write) + bord (table).

cards.forms: här och var · hit och dit
cards.sentence_en: 'Här och var' means a bit everywhere.
Here's my passport.
cards.note: Also a shift at work: ett nattpass.

cards.sentence_en: Here's a speaker.
cards.note: högt (loud) + talare (speaker).

cards.sentence: Det här gosedjuret vann jag i Taiwan och här uppe hänger till och med Taiwan.
cards.sentence_en: I won this cuddly toy in Taiwan, and up here even Taiwan is hanging.
cards.note: ett gosedjur = a cuddly toy. Also 'up to and including': till och med fredag.

cards.sentence_en: A shout-out to my Taiwanese viewers.
cards.note: From titta = to watch.

cards.sentence: Det här är en av mina favoritskivor.
cards.sentence_en: This is one of my favourite records.
cards.note: Also a slice: en skiva bröd.

cards.sentence_en: You should listen to it.
The courage to be disliked.
cards.note: modig = brave. ett mode (with -e) = fashion.

cards.sentence_en: Do you have the courage to be disliked?
cards.note: o- + gillad (liked).

cards.forms: dricker upp · drack upp · har druckit upp
cards.english: to drink up, to finish (a drink)
cards.sentence_en: I have time to finish my coffee.
cards.note: upp = finish it off: äta upp = eat it all. hinna = have time to.

cards.sentence: Det är ett fotografi på mig och min morfar.
cards.sentence_en: It's a photo of me and my grandfather.
cards.note: mor + far. Father's father = farfar; grandmothers are mormor and farmor.

cards.forms: är sig lik · var sig lik
cards.english: to look like oneself, to be unchanged
cards.sentence_en: Do I look the same (as back then)?
cards.note: Han är sig lik = he hasn't changed a bit.

cards.sentence_en: Here are my friends and colleagues.
cards.note: Also arbetskamrat, casually jobbarkompis.

cards.sentence: Och då ska jag ha med några galgar för att hänga upp skjortor i torkrummet.
cards.sentence_en: And then I'll bring some hangers to hang up shirts in the drying room.
cards.note: en galge = a clothes hanger, pronounced 'galje'.

cards.english: to stop, to finish, to quit
cards.sentence_en: They've stopped washing.
cards.note: sluta röka = quit smoking. slut = end.

cards.sentence_en: Now I'm sorting the clothes.
Now the clothes are wet.
cards.note: Opposite: torr. Slightly wet = fuktig.

cards.sentence_en: So I press the one.
cards.note: Numbers as nouns: en tvåa (also a 2-room flat), ta sexan = take the number 6 (bus/tram).

cards.sentence: Det tar visst en timme och 13 minuter.
cards.sentence_en: Apparently it takes an hour and 13 minutes.
cards.note: Visst! on its own = Sure! Of course!

cards.sentence: T-shirten har ett tryck, så jag vill inte lägga den i torktumlaren.
cards.sentence_en: The T-shirt has a print, so I don't want to put it in the dryer.

cards.sentence: Jag hänger upp den i torkrummet istället.
cards.sentence_en: I hang it up in the drying room instead.
cards.note: istället för = instead of.

cards.forms: tar fram · tog fram · har tagit fram
cards.english: to take out, to get out
cards.sentence: Det här är mitt hänglås, så jag tar fram min nyckel och öppnar hänglåset.
cards.sentence_en: This is my padlock, so I take out my key and open the padlock.
cards.note: en nyckel = a key.

cards.sentence: Även om det står 17 till 22 brukar vi svenskar säga fem till tio på kvällen.
cards.sentence_en: Even though it says 17 to 22, we Swedes usually say five to ten in the evening.
cards.note: Signs use the 24-hour clock; in speech Swedes use the 12-hour clock.

cards.forms: låser fast · låste fast · har låst fast
cards.sentence: Så jag hänger upp mitt hänglås här och låser fast det.
cards.sentence_en: So I hang up my padlock here and lock it in place.
cards.note: låsa = to lock; ett lås = a lock.

cards.sentence_en: Now I'm in the stairwell.
cards.note: The shared stairs and hallway of an apartment building.

cards.sentence_en: The lift goes between different floors.
cards.note: bottenvåning = ground floor. en hiss = a lift.

cards.sentence: Gillar du att ta hissen eller ta trappan?
cards.sentence_en: Do you like taking the lift or the stairs?
Here's our courtyard.
cards.note: The garden inside a block of buildings.

cards.sentence_en: There's a gate there.
cards.note: A small gate in a fence; a big one is en port.

cards.sentence_en: That's called overcast.
cards.note: Det är mulet = it's overcast, grey sky everywhere.

cards.sentence_en: Right now it's drizzling.
cards.note: duggregn = drizzle.

cards.sentence_en: There are some leaves lying on the bench.
cards.note: Same in singular and plural: ett löv, två löv.

cards.sentence_en: This tree is a birch.
cards.note: The most common tree in Sweden. björklöv = birch leaves.

cards.sentence: När löven faller, eller hösten kommer och löven faller, så skiftar löven färg.
cards.sentence_en: When the leaves fall, or autumn comes and the leaves fall, the leaves change colour.
cards.note: skifta färg = change colour; everyday: byta färg.

cards.sentence_en: Autumn is coming soon.
cards.note: Seasons: vår, sommar, höst, vinter.

cards.sentence: Och här på marken ligger det en fjäder.
cards.sentence_en: And here on the ground there's a feather.
cards.note: Also a metal spring.

cards.sentence: Det är en fågel som har tappat sin fjäder.
cards.sentence_en: It's a bird that has lost its feather.
cards.note: Jag tappade telefonen = I dropped my phone.

cards.sentence_en: This is a fence.
cards.note: Often wire or mesh; a wooden fence is usually staket.

cards.sentence_en: A moment ago we were outdoors.
This is called lint.

cards.forms: tar bort · tog bort · har tagit bort
cards.sentence_en: I have to remove all the lint.

cards.sentence: Du måste ta bort luddet från filtret på torktumlaren, annars blir dina grannar förbannade.
cards.sentence_en: You have to remove the lint from the dryer filter, otherwise your neighbours get angry.
cards.note: Stronger and more casual than arg. en granne = a neighbour.

cards.sentence_en: Now these clothes are freshly washed.
It's not dirty laundry any more.

cards.sentence: Nu hänger jag in skjortan i min garderob på en gång.
cards.sentence_en: Now I hang the shirt in my wardrobe right away.
cards.note: Also the cloakroom at a restaurant or club.

cards.sentence_en: 'På en gång' means right away.
cards.note: Also 'at the same time': två saker på en gång.

cards.sentence: Och nu ska jag sortera och vika kläderna.
cards.sentence_en: And now I'm going to sort and fold the clothes.
cards.note: vika ihop = fold up.

cards.sentence_en: A sock or socks are an item of clothing.
cards.note: kläder has no singular, so one piece is ett klädesplagg.

cards.forms: parar ihop · parade ihop · har parat ihop
cards.sentence: Den måste jag para ihop med en likadan strumpa som är någonstans här i.
cards.sentence_en: I have to pair it with a matching sock that's somewhere in here.
cards.note: likadan = identical, the same kind.

cards.sentence_en: I'll hang it here for now.
cards.note: Also 'as long as': så länge du vill.

cards.sentence_en: Here's a tank top.
cards.note: Also the fabric linen.

cards.sentence_en: The tank top has no sleeves.
cards.note: kortärmad = short-sleeved.

cards.sentence_en: Some belong to my partner.
cards.note: From samboende (living together). Very common in Sweden; legally recognised.

cards.sentence_en: 'Sambo' is a useful Swedish word.
cards.note: använda (to use) + -bar (-able).

cards.sentence_en: Here's a pair of underpants.
cards.note: Women's: trosor.

cards.sentence: Kläderna som ska till min sambos garderob sorterar jag i en annan hög.
cards.sentence_en: The clothes that go in my partner's wardrobe I sort into another pile.
cards.note: Same word as the adjective hög (high).

cards.forms: plockar upp · plockade upp · har plockat upp
cards.sentence: Jag har inte plockat upp alla strumpor än.
cards.sentence_en: I haven't picked up all the socks yet.

cards.sentence: Grodorna dansar och det är en säl som är DJ.
cards.sentence_en: The frogs are dancing and there's a seal who's the DJ.

cards.forms: kollar in · kollade in · har kollat in
cards.sentence: Och vill du lära dig ännu mera svenska så kolla in den här videon.
cards.sentence_en: And if you want to learn even more Swedish, check out this video.
